item.title: News
item.description:
• 2026-11-14 · Congratulations to Shuo Wang, Chen Wang, Hao Hui, Yinbin Gao and Xunchen Liu on the publication of Auto-ignition dynamics of a reacting jet in vitiated crossflow studied by burst-mode PIV and PLIF thermometry in Experimental Thermal and Fluid Science, 2026, 179: 111859.
  • 2026-09-01 · Welcome the 2026 M.Sc. students: Xie Jingtong, Wu Wenshuo, Liu Yongji and Adrien
  • 2026-06-28 · The low-altitude economy conference was held on 28 June
  • 2025-09-01 · Welcome the 2025 M.Sc. students: Zhang Hongmin, Zhao Dianhu, Ran Jiaxing, Zhao Xinhao and Zhang Jiayi
  • Visit to Prof. Cheng Song’s lab, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
